references.text: The tribe of Judah was unable to drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem, which contrasts with the conquest mentioned in Judges 1:8
David later conquered Jerusalem from the Jebusites and made it his capital, showing the city's continued significance after the events in Judges
Joshua captured Jerusalem and killed its king, a prior conquest that relates to Judah's struggle against the city
The king of Jerusalem is listed among the kings whom Joshua defeated, reflecting the city's earlier history with Israelite conquest
The tribe of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites from Jerusalem, illustrating the complex conquest history of the city
Israel vowed to devote the cities of the Canaanites to destruction, a pattern followed in the conquest of Jerusalem
